lines.2: 「Inori overslept and will be late. I flew on ahead by myself.」
lines.4: Actually, yesterday was unusual because she had arrived early.
lines.6: 「Settle down, chicks. I hate birds that chirp and squawk all day.」
lines.7: 「Allow me to share some valuable wisdom. Listen well: you can catch plenty of snakeheads in rivers.」
lines.8: What century was that bird from...?
